description:
Updated 3BR/2BA Home with Modern Finishes and Spacious Backyard

Tucked into an established Killeen neighborhood, this 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home offers a refreshed interior and an easy, comfortable layout that stands out the moment you walk in. With the home currently vacant, it creates a smooth move in experience for renters ready to settle in without delay.

Inside, you’ll notice the open living area anchored by a modernized fireplace and updated flooring that flows throughout the main spaces. Natural light fills the home through large windows and sliding glass doors, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The kitchen has been thoughtfully updated with sleek countertops, stainless appliances, and a breakfast bar that connects seamlessly to the dining and living areas, making everyday living feel connected and convenient.

The bedrooms offer a softer, more private retreat with fresh carpet and clean finishes, while the bathrooms feature updated vanities and fixtures that give a more modern feel. Step outside to a spacious backyard shaded by mature trees, offering plenty of room to relax, unwind, or enjoy time outdoors.

Homes with this level of updates, space, and move in readiness tend to draw attention quickly. Reach out today to request more information or schedule a private showing before it becomes widely available.
